summary: Closed the last unmeasured item of the replay question with a default-configuration experiment. Added source src_snapshot_cadence (snapshot.go:71-95: runSnapshots wakes on a randomized timeout of up to SnapshotInterval before checking shouldSnapshot) and submitted draft/assurance_generated_test.go's TestAssuranceRestoreCommittedLogsDefaultConfiguration: two single-voter prefixes with DefaultConfig untouched (SnapshotThreshold 8192, MaxAppendEntries 64, SnapshotInterval 120s), 12000 commands each, reporting the committed range above the newest snapshot, the bound of 128*MaxAppendEntries and whether any snapshot existed, then restarting with the replay on and off. Two comparisons: with the range above the bound the replay-enabled restart must return (antecedent delta_exceeds_bound), and the flag-off control must return. Local construction feedback showed staged commit index 12001 with snapshot index 0 and no listed snapshots (range 12001 > bound 8192), the replay-on restart not returning within 8000ms with restoreFromCommittedLogs in the stack, and the flag-off restart returning in 1ms; the retained receipt is requested. The successor interpretation that turns this counterevidence into a measured statement remains for the next turn if the run allows.
